triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: B-8092 is accepted when the worktree contains local Docker probe tooling plus probe evidence showing image/Codex CLI smoke, sterile input manifest, probe receipt rows, contamination negative controls, and merge validation results, without running full Cell06 or upgrading paper claims.
acceptanceBindings.note: All four checklist items and their 12 verificationIntent refs jointly prove the bounded local Docker probe path and validators.

note: ProofStory contract binds the original acceptance claim to the four checklist items and all 12 verificationIntent refs.
